long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Mexico in 1976, Héctor Fabián Gómez-Sáinz García entered his family’s food group while young and became a significant shareholder. The third-generation business grew from Cantabrian emigrants’ grocery trade into a major Mexican edible-oils enterprise. In Spain, he represented the family holding Hidafa on boards including Cortefiel, OHL and General de Alquiler de Maquinaria.

Liquid Investments became the vehicle for Gómez-Sáinz’s Spanish portfolio. His holdings have included sizeable positions in listed industrial, property and hospitality companies, while he remains a major shareholder of Grupo Hotelero Santa Fe. Liquid Investments also took control of Beka Finance, placing a diversified asset-management and financial-services platform at the centre of his current business activity.
